inAppApplicationHint: All job applications happen safely inside WHY ME. Never pay any fee to apply or attend an interview.
applySoon: Online CV & one-tap application arrives in the next update.
noJobsFound: No open jobs match your filters right now.
noJobsHint: Try clearing a filter or checking another area in Delta State.
employerIntro: Set up your company profile and post vacancies to reach job seekers across Delta State.
enableEmployerBody: Turn on employer features for your account to create a company profile and post job vacancies.
companyProfileHint: Shown on every vacancy you publish. Keep phone numbers, emails and external links out of your profile.
companyAboutHint: What your company does and what applicants should know.
freeJobBannerTitle: Your first standard job post is free for {{days}} days
freeJobBannerBody: Your free job entitlement is only used when your first vacancy is approved and published—not while it is a draft.
freeJobUsedBody: Your first free 30-day job post has been used. Additional paid (₦2,000) and featured (₦2,800) job posts are coming soon.
noVacancies: You haven't created any job vacancies yet.
jobTitleHint: For example: Sales Representative or Electrical Apprentice
jobDescriptionHint: Responsibilities, working hours and what the role involves (at least 20 characters). Do not include phone numbers or emails.
jobExperienceHint: For example: Entry level, or 2+ years in retail
seekerProfileSubtitle: Build your profile, upload a PDF or Word CV, or generate a clean PDF CV directly from your profile.
seekerProfileHint: Used when you apply for jobs or generate a WHY ME PDF CV. Do not include phone numbers, email addresses or links—employers message you inside WHY ME.
headlineHint: For example: Certified Electrical & Solar Technician
bioHint: Briefly describe your background, strengths and the roles you are looking for.
skillsHint: Separate skills with commas (for example: Three-phase wiring, Solar inverter installation, Fault diagnosis).
discoverableLabel: Allow verified employers to discover my profile when candidate search opens (optional)
discoverableHint: Your CV is private by default. Only employers you apply to can open your CV.
cvsHint: You can keep up to 5 CVs on your account. Files are stored privately and screened for contact details.
generateCvBody: Creates a clean, formatted PDF CV from your seeker profile above, with contact details omitted for your safety.
uploadCvBody: Maximum 5 MB. Remove phone numbers, emails and external links from the document before uploading.
noCvsYet: You haven't uploaded or generated a CV yet.
myApplicationsSubtitle: Track the jobs you have applied for and review applicants for your own vacancies.
noApplicationsYet: You haven't applied for any jobs yet.
noEmployerApplicationsYet: No applications have been submitted to your vacancies yet.
coverNoteHint: Briefly explain why you fit this role. Do not include phone numbers, emails or external links.
alreadyAppliedTitle: You have applied for this job
needCvBeforeApply: Create or upload a CV first so you can attach it to your application.
signInToApply: Sign in to apply for this job

applicationStatusHint.applied: Your application and CV have been delivered to the employer.
applicationStatusHint.reviewing: The employer is reviewing your application and CV.
applicationStatusHint.shortlisted: You have been shortlisted! You and the employer can coordinate next steps in chat.
applicationStatusHint.rejected: The employer decided not to proceed with this application.
applicationStatusHint.withdrawn: You withdrew this application. Withdrawal is final for this vacancy.

noApplicantsForVacancy: No applicants yet for this vacancy.
